definitions.explanation: A point in time after the present or after a reference point.
The time to come; future circumstances.

examples.japanese: {後|のち}⟦ほど→ほど：01724_hodo⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{後|のち}⟦{晴|は}れる→晴れる：00701_hareru⟧⟦でしょう→でしょう：09887_deshou⟧。
examples.english: It will probably clear up after the rain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧{後|のち}、⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{後|のち}、⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見直|みなお}された→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧。
examples.english: After the accident, safety measures were reviewed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{後|のち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{詳|くわ}しい→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: I will give a detailed report after the meeting.

examples.japanese: {後|のち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{考|かんが}えていない→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: I haven't thought about what comes later.
To leave one's name for future generations.
examples.notes: {後|のち}の{世|よ} = future generations, posterity

examples.japanese: {後|のち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It became a big problem later on.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{決定|けってい}→決定：02701_kettei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{後|のち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えるか→与える：01821_ataeru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: We don't yet know what effect this decision will have in the future.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{出来事|できごと}→出来事：03446_dekigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{後|のち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}ると→振り返る：04231_furikaeru⟧、⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: Looking back on it later, I think that event was an important experience.

notes:
USAGE: {後|のち} is a more formal/literary way to say 'after' or 'later' compared to ⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧. It's commonly used in weather forecasts and formal writing.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{後|のち} (after ~)
- {後|のち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (later, subsequently)
- {後|のち}⟦ほど→ほど：01724_hodo⟧ (later - polite)
- {後|のち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世|よ}→世：00424_yo⟧ (future generations, posterity)

WEATHER EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧{後|のち}⟦{曇|くも}り→曇り：02875_kumori⟧ (rain, then cloudy)
- ⟦{晴|は}れ→晴れ：02936_hare⟧{後|のち}⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧ (clear, then rain)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {後|のち} - afterwards (formal/literary)
- ⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧ - after, later (everyday)
- ⟦{以後|いご}→以後：01710_igo⟧ - after, since (formal)
- ⟦その{後|ご}→その後：08501_sonogo⟧ - after that
